scientific_integrity: The all-degree assertion is supported by an analytic orthogonality/optimization/Laplace proof; exact-arithmetic and finite numerical checks are independent consistency tests, not infinite proof or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only inverse approximation by polynomials in one fixed affine linear form; no uniform constants in degenerating weight vectors; no new unrestricted higher-dimensional cyclicity theorem.
title: Exact one-generator approximation threshold in radial Dirichlet polydisk spaces
